georef.rotation.help: The angle between the map grid and your project grid, counter-clockwise. 0 means the project axes follow the map.
georef.format.label: Angle format

georef.trueNorth.help: Computed from the meridian convergence at the base point and the grid rotation.

georef.scale.help: Leave at 1 unless your surveyor gave you a project scale.
georef.survey.title: Survey point (optional)
georef.survey.help: The map coordinates of a known benchmark, in metres. Leave empty if you have none.

georef.error.not_georeferenced: The project has no location yet.
georef.panel.empty: This project has no location yet. Place it on a coordinate system to read and enter map and latitude/longitude coordinates.
georef.panel.pickDisabled: Available when the 3D view is ready.
georef.block.heightApprox: Height is approximate: there is no geoid model yet.
georef.convert.outside: This point is too far from the projection to convert.
